title: 8.1.10 Lab: Sketch and Pull
description: Draw a flat rectangle, then pull it up into a solid 10 mm tall. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Draw a rectangle
steps.instructions: Press the Sketch tool in the toolbar. reSHape opens the 2D sketch editor with a flat rectangle already drawn on the ground plane, 40 mm by 25 mm. Leave its size as it is.
hints: Nothing is solid yet - a sketch is flat, like a drawing on a piece of paper lying on the ground.
The toolbar changes to drawing tools (Select, Line, Rect, Circle ...) while you are in the sketch editor. That is normal.

steps.title: Finish the sketch
steps.instructions: Press the Done button at the left of the toolbar to leave the sketch editor and go back to the 3D view. The toolbar goes back to Sketch, Box, Pull, Spin ... and Sketch 1 shows in the timeline at the bottom.
hints: Done is the button with the left arrow, next to the Sketch group of the toolbar.
If the toolbar still shows Line, Rect and Circle, you are still inside the sketch editor. Press Done.

steps.title: Pull it into a solid
steps.instructions: With Sketch 1 selected, press the Pull tool in the toolbar. In the Dimensions panel, the height reads 12 - type 10 in the "Pull 1 height" field.
hints: The rectangle turns into a solid block. After you type 10 it stands 10 mm tall.
If Pull is greyed out, click the "Sketch 1" chip in the timeline at the bottom first, then press Pull.

requirements.title: A 40 x 25 rectangle pulled 10 mm tall
requirements.description: A flat 40 mm by 25 mm rectangle (the one the Sketch tool draws), pulled into a solid 10 mm tall.
requirements.hint: Press Sketch, leave the 40 x 25 rectangle as it is, press Done, then press Pull and type 10 in the Pull 1 height field.
